basis: rtl/hbm_accel/sm/ot_hbm_accel_sm_v.sv boundary/latency constants DS2 DW4 DG3 PIO2 STK1
scope: one existing full-shape SM connected to existing ctl parent, not a complete layer scheduler
area_basis: Explicit conservative sizing only: 116FF at1um2 plus300 twoinput equivalent gates at0.5um2, doubled for placement. No measured spare area/track credit.
latency_edges: plan acceptance -> held descriptor (positive variable d_ready wait) -> accepted descriptor -> START one edge -> RUN; completion only after actual rows, changed arrive and actual released; registered eng_done sampled next ctl edge. SM PIO and native arithmetic remain unchanged.
result_capacity: caller must reserve op_rows*NC*32 bits before plan acceptance; no-ready SM output unchanged, no hidden FIFO or fake ready
